content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the VNIT Nagpur Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: 4-year B.Tech./Bachelor's/MTech Degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) or equivalent/related discipline from a recognized University/Institution, with First Class or minimum CGPA of 6.5/10, and qualified GATE in relevant discipline with valid score

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: Rs.37,000/- per month + HRA (8%)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for VNIT Nagpur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology Nagpur (VNIT Nagpur), a premier government institution.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the JRF post in this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for VNIT Nagpur JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application via email is 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply for the JRF posts through email, as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 4-year B.Tech./MTech Degree in ECE or equivalent with First Class and a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the JRF post at VNIT Nagpur?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the JRF post will receive a salary of Rs.37,000/- per month along with HRA (8%).

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for VNIT Nagpur JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF post includes a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology located?
faq.answer: Visvesvaraya National Institute of Technology (VNIT) is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with pincode 440010.
